name: @spikypanda/plugin-helios
description: Helios plugin for SpikyPanda: framework primitives + agent runtime building blocks for the Helios embodied-AI ECLSS simulator. Sim primitives (rng, snapshot/restore, rate-divider, conservation monitor), agent runtime (alert bus, arbitrator), and generic sensor/actuator wrappers. Chemistry plant nodes + sub-graph-as-ONNX export land in subsequent versions once the ISimNode/ISimGraph framework is finalized.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile
